AGENT_TESTER.TITLE: Agent tester
AGENT_TESTER.SUBTITLE: Test any agent (Engine 1.0 or 2.0) as if you were the customer. The real engine answers in a test channel: nothing goes to WhatsApp. With 👎 we tell you if the error is in the prompt, the content, the model or the engine.
AGENT_TESTER.READY: Ready: write to {name} (Engine {engine}) as a customer would.
AGENT_TESTER.NO_REPLY: The agent did not answer (it may be paused or without follow-up).
AGENT_TESTER.TRACKING_STATUS: The follow-up is «{status}»: the agent no longer answers in this chat. Start a new one.
AGENT_TESTER.WHAT_WRONG: What went wrong and how should it have answered?
AGENT_TESTER.WHAT_WRONG_PH: E.g.: it gave both scholarships at once
AGENT_TESTER.SHARED: ⓘ Canned responses are also used by your team and other agents.
AGENT_TESTER.SAVE_CASE_HINT: Errors marked with 👎 are saved automatically. Use this to save a chat you want to protect (e.g. one that went well): it goes to the agent’s batch of the day.
AGENT_TESTER.EXPECTED_PH: What is expected from the last reply

BATCHES.HINT: Grouped tests run in full against an agent. Each test is what the customer writes (one or more messages) and what is expected.
BATCHES.MESSAGES_PH: What the customer writes, one message per line
BATCHES.EXPECTED_PH: What is expected from the last reply
BATCHES.RUNNING: Running: progress shows on the batch card.
BATCHES.RUN_ALL: Run all tests of this agent
BATCHES.RUN_ALL_HINT: Joins the tests of all its days in one run: to see if any past error came back.

LOG.TODO_PROMPT: Paste it in that part of the agent's Training, save and press «Fixed · test again».
LOG.TODO_SEARCH: Open that canned response, add this text at the start, save and press «Fixed · test again».
LOG.TODO_CONTENT: Fix that text in its source, save and press «Fixed · test again».
LOG.RETESTING: Testing again with the agent as it is now…
LOG.RETEST_PASSED: ✅ Fixed: it now replies as expected.
LOG.RETEST_FAILED: ❌ Still failing: check the change and test again.

AGENT_TESTER.AUTO_SAVED: Saved in the Log (Corrections) with what to do, and as a test in «{batch}». If you leave, pick it up from there.
AGENT_TESTER.OUTDATED: This agent changed after the chat started: start a new chat to test the new version.
AGENT_TESTER.NO_AGENTS: There are no agents in testing right now. Whoever manages agents puts them «In testing» in AI Agents › Agents.
AGENT_TESTER.ASK_ADMIN: Tell whoever manages the agent so they fix it; it is already in the log and saved as a test.
